root_cause.text: The `rndis_bind` function accesses the `class`, `subclass`, and `protocol` fields of `struct f_rndis_opts` without holding the `rndis_opts->lock` mutex, allowing concurrent modifications of these options via configfs to cause a race condition.
root_cause.evidence: The patch introduces a `scoped_guard(mutex, &rndis_opts->lock)` block in `drivers/usb/gadget/function/f_rndis.c` around the assignments of `rndis_iad_descriptor.bFunctionClass`, `bFunctionSubClass`, and `bFunctionProtocol` from `rndis_opts` to prevent concurrent access.
